explication: GAIA is a local-first AI agent framework and desktop application for building and using tool-enabled agents. The principal workflow is a user request entering through the UI or API, being handled by an agent that can invoke tools and local or optional cloud models, and returning a response. Major documented branches include RAG, voice, vision, MCP, plugins, and the C++ framework. The graph reflects README claims and the supplied source index; unsampled subsystems are represented at their documented boundaries, and unsupported internal links are omitted.
